request: also show how much silver zakat would be if i add silver

checklist.item: has an input for silver
silver is included in the zakat total
existing cash and gold inputs still present

program:
app "Zakat" coin mint
state gold num = 0
state gold_rate money = 0
state silver num = 0
state silver_rate money = 0
state cash money = 0
let total = gold * gold_rate + silver * silver_rate + cash
let nisab = 52.5 * silver_rate
stack card gap 2
  field gold "Gold (tola)"
  field gold_rate "Gold rate per tola"
  field silver "Silver (tola)"
  field silver_rate "Silver rate per tola"
  field cash "Cash at home and savings"
"Total wealth" total head
stat total * 0.025, "zakat due (2.5 percent)"
row gap 3
  stat gold * gold_rate * 0.025, "gold zakat"
  stat silver * silver_rate * 0.025, "silver zakat"
  stat cash * 0.025, "cash zakat"
if silver_rate > 0
  if total >= nisab
    "Above nisab (52.5 tola silver = " nisab "): zakat is due" color good
  else
    "Below nisab (" nisab "): no zakat due" color warn
describe:
Zakat, in the mint colours.
Works out:
- total is gold times gold rate plus silver times silver rate plus cash.
- nisab is 52.5 times silver rate.
Remembers while you use it: gold, starting at 0; gold rate, starting at 0; silver, starting at 0; silver rate, starting at 0; cash, starting at 0.
Shows:
- a box to fill in gold, labelled "Gold (tola)".
- a box to fill in gold rate, labelled "Gold rate per tola".
- a box to fill in silver, labelled "Silver (tola)".
- a box to fill in silver rate, labelled "Silver rate per tola".
- a box to fill in cash, labelled "Cash at home and savings".
- text: "Total wealth", total.
- a big number: total times 0.025, labelled "zakat due 2.5 percent".
- a big number: gold times gold rate times 0.025, labelled "gold zakat".
- a big number: silver times silver rate times 0.025, labelled "silver zakat".
- a big number: cash times 0.025, labelled "cash zakat".
- if silver rate is more than 0:
  - if total is at least nisab:
    - text: "Above nisab (52.5 tola silver = ", nisab, "): zakat is due".
  - otherwise:
    - text: "Below nisab (", nisab, "): no zakat due".

request: Home tuition centre app: students with class and monthly fee, fee payments with date and amount, attendance by day, a monthly fee collected chart, and a reminder on the 5th to collect fees.

checklist.item: can add students with name, class and monthly fee
can record fee payments linked to a student with amount
attendance can be marked per student per day
chart of fees collected per month

program:
app "Quiz" brain ocean
table answer q num 1..5, ok bool
state qi num = 1
let ques(n num) = if(n = 1, "Capital of Pakistan?", if(n = 2, "How many continents are there?", if(n = 3, "Largest planet?", if(n = 4, "Boiling point of water in C?", "Fastest land animal?"))))
let oa(n num) = if(n = 1, "Karachi", if(n = 2, "7", if(n = 3, "Mars", if(n = 4, "90", "Lion"))))
let ob(n num) = if(n = 1, "Islamabad", if(n = 2, "5", if(n = 3, "Jupiter", if(n = 4, "120", "Cheetah"))))
let oc(n num) = if(n = 1, "Lahore", if(n = 2, "6", if(n = 3, "Saturn", if(n = 4, "100", "Horse"))))
let right(n num) = if(n = 1, 2, if(n = 2, 1, if(n = 3, 2, if(n = 4, 3, 2))))
let answered = count(answer where q = qi) > 0
if qi > 5
  stat count(answer where ok = yes), "score out of 5"
  button "Restart" tap remove all answer then set qi = 1
else
  "Question" qi "of 5" faint
  text ques(qi) head
  button oa(qi) tap add answer q = qi, ok = right(qi) = 1
  button ob(qi) tap add answer q = qi, ok = right(qi) = 2
  button oc(qi) tap add answer q = qi, ok = right(qi) = 3
  if answered
    if(last(answer.ok), "Correct", "Wrong") bold color if(last(answer.ok), good, bad)
    button "Next" tap set qi = qi + 1
describe:
Quiz, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- answer: q: number, 1 to 5; ok: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- answered is how many answer entries where q is qi is more than 0.
Remembers while you use it: qi, starting at 1.
Shows:
- if qi is more than 5:
  - a big number: how many answer entries where ok is yes, labelled "score out of 5".
  - a button "Restart"; a tap removes all answer entries, with one undo, then sets qi to 1.
- otherwise:
  - text: "Question", qi, "of 5".
  - text: "Capital of Pakistan?" when qi is 1, otherwise "How many continents are there?" when qi is 2, otherwise "Largest planet?" when qi is 3, otherwise "Boiling point of water in C?" when qi is 4, otherwise "Fastest land animal?".
  - a button "Karachi" when qi is 1, otherwise "7" when qi is 2, otherwise "Mars" when qi is 3, otherwise "90" when qi is 4, otherwise "Lion"; a tap adds a answer with q set to qi, ok set to 2 when qi is 1, otherwise 1 when qi is 2, otherwise 2 when qi is 3, otherwise 3 when qi is 4, otherwise 2 is 1.
  - a button "Islamabad" when qi is 1, otherwise "5" when qi is 2, otherwise "Jupiter" when qi is 3, otherwise "120" when qi is 4, otherwise "Cheetah"; a tap adds a answer with q set to qi, ok set to 2 when qi is 1, otherwise 1 when qi is 2, otherwise 2 when qi is 3, otherwise 3 when qi is 4, otherwise 2 is 2.
  - a button "Lahore" when qi is 1, otherwise "6" when qi is 2, otherwise "Saturn" when qi is 3, otherwise "100" when qi is 4, otherwise "Horse"; a tap adds a answer with q set to qi, ok set to 2 when qi is 1, otherwise 1 when qi is 2, otherwise 2 when qi is 3, otherwise 3 when qi is 4, otherwise 2 is 3.
  - if answered:
    - text: "Correct" when the latest ok of answer, otherwise "Wrong".
    - a button "Next"; a tap sets qi to qi plus 1.

table client name text
table project name text, client ref client, rate money

- entry: project: a project; hours: number, at least 0; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.

- a screen "Invoices":
- a form to add a invoice.
- for each invoice:

program:

table review pr text, tests bool, secrets bool, naming bool, errors bool, docs bool
stat count(review where tests = yes and secrets = yes and naming = yes and errors = yes and docs = yes), "PRs fully passed"
state d new review keep
stack card gap 1
  field d.pr "PR name"
  toggle d.tests
  "Tests added" faint
  toggle d.secrets
  "No secrets" faint

- a tick box for the tests of the d.
- text: "Tests added".
- a tick box for the secrets of the d.
- text: "No secrets".
- a tick box for the naming of the d.
- text: "Naming ok".
- a tick box for the errors of the d.
- text: "Error handling".
- a tick box for the docs of the d.
- text: "Docs updated".

program:
app "Tea timer" cup mint
state secs dur = 4m
state kind pick Green|Black|Doodh_patti = Black
state ends when = now
state going bool = no
when going and now >= ends set going = no then notify "Your tea is ready"
row gap 1
  button "Green 2 min" fill if(kind = Green, accent, soft) tap set kind = Green then set secs = 2m then set going = no
  button "Black 4 min" fill if(kind = Black, accent, soft) tap set kind = Black then set secs = 4m then set going = no

button "Start" large tap set ends = now + secs then set going = yes
describe:
Tea timer, in the mint colours.
Remembers while you use it: secs, starting at 4 minutes; kind, starting at Black; ends, starting at now; going, starting at no.
Shows:
- when going and now is at least ends, it sets going to no, then shows the notice "Your tea is ready".

- a button "Doodh patti 6 min"; a tap sets kind to Doodh patti, then sets secs to 6 minutes, then sets going to no.
- text: the larger of ends minus now and 0 hours when going, otherwise secs.

program:
app "Plank intervals" timer ocean
state round num = 1
state resting bool = no
state going bool = no
state ends when = now
setting work dur = 40s "Hold"
setting rest dur = 20s "Rest"
when going and now >= ends and round >= 6 and not resting set going = no then notify "All 6 rounds done"
when going and now >= ends and not resting and round < 6 set resting = yes then set ends = now + rest
when going and now >= ends and resting set resting = no then set round = round + 1 then set ends = now + work
"Round" round "of 6" head
text if(going, if(resting, "Rest", "Hold"), "Ready") big color if(resting, good, accent)
text if(going, max(ends - now, 0s), work) big
row gap 1
  button "Start" tap set round = 1 then set resting = no then set ends = now + work then set going = yes
  button "Stop" tap set going = no
describe:
Plank intervals, in the ocean colours.
You can change: "Hold": length of time, starts at 40 seconds; "Rest": length of time, starts at 20 seconds.
Remembers while you use it: round, starting at 1; resting, starting at no; going, starting at no; ends, starting at now.
Shows:
- when going and now is at least ends and round is at least 6 and not resting, it sets going to no, then shows the notice "All 6 rounds done".
- when going and now is at least ends and not resting and round is less than 6, it sets resting to yes, then sets ends to now plus rest.
- when going and now is at least ends and resting, it sets resting to no, then sets round to round plus 1, then sets ends to now plus work.
- text: "Round", round, "of 6".
- text: "Rest" when resting, otherwise "Hold" when going, otherwise "Ready".
- text: the larger of ends minus now and 0 hours when going, otherwise work.
- a button "Start"; a tap sets round to 1, then sets resting to no, then sets ends to now plus work, then sets going to yes.
- a button "Stop"; a tap sets going to no.
